name: themeparks-web
description: Theme park live ride status, wait times, virtual queues, ride details, best time to ride, park hours, and minute-level ride downtime history from the free ThemeParks.wiki API. Works keyless; an optional free key extends history to 30 days and enables live push. Powered by ThemeParks.wiki. Unofficial; not affiliated with ThemeParks.wiki or any park.
